title: The 3x+1 Problem: Two Stochastic Models

consultation.scope: Abstract and indexed introductory passage on page 231 in Lagarias's public upload; publication metadata checked against his bibliography.
consultation.remaining: Scanned full text located, but Sections 2-5 and their proofs were not inspected in this pass.

notes: Forward random walks model residue dynamics modulo powers of two; backward branching random walks model inverse dynamics modulo powers of three. The shared stopping-time constant about 41.677647 is a theorem for these stochastic models, not for deterministic Collatz trajectories. Useful prior art for rate heuristics, not a certified Juggler parity law or Paper C's missing quantitative hypothesis.
